title: 小型コンクリートミキサー
description: 内部の羽根が見える中空ドラム、支持ヨーク、傾斜ハンドルと運搬車輪を備えた小型ミキサー。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: Compact mixer with hollow tilted drum, internal mixing paddles, support yoke, tilt handwheel, motor housing and transport wheels. Static visualization prop. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
